_comment: Manual match results, read by pipeline/settle_results.py.
One entry per fixture. The fixture name must be the one the ledger
recorded ('Home v Away'); matching ignores case and extra spacing.
'source' is not read by the code. It is here because a settled ledger is
a financial record: every scoreline in it should be traceable to where it
was read from, and a wrong entry here silently restates the PnL.
These ten entries are the 2025/26 final matchday, 24 May 2026, checked
against ESPN and at least one independent source each. Verify before
